fields.System.Title: RPL-103 — Bulk-load replenishment rules
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want to load rules for hundreds of pick faces from a file,
so that setting up replenishment does not take a week of manual entry.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a valid file, then every rule is created.
  • - Given any invalid row, then nothing is imported and all problems are reported at
  • once with row numbers.
  • - Given rows failing the min/max validation from
  • [RPL-102](RPL-102-validate-min-below-max.md), then they are reported as invalid.
  • - Given a row for a location that already has a rule, then it updates the existing rule
  • rather than failing, if update mode is selected.
  • - Given the same file imported twice, then the result is unchanged.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | replenishment |
| Tables | replen_rule |
| Risks | Partial import ([doc 09 §11.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency |
